ambiguities.text: Store migration 'may occur before CAPELLA_FORK_EPOCH' without specifying exactly when it should be triggered
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume migration is triggered when the node software is upgraded and detects that Capella fork is configured, regardless of current epoch. This is an assumption.

ambiguities.text: No specification of what happens if the upgrade is applied to already-Capella-format data
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume upgrade functions are idempotent or should only be called on Altair-format data. Implementation should guard against double-upgrade.

implicit_assumptions.description: Empty ExecutionPayloadHeader and ExecutionBranch used during upgrade are safe defaults that won't pass validation as real execution data
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: An attacker could craft data that appears to have valid execution proofs using the empty default values.

implicit_assumptions.description: Pre-Capella data exchanged over the network maintains its original format and is not tampered with before local conversion
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Malformed pre-Capella data could exploit the upgrade path to inject invalid state into the Capella store.
